content:
Возвращение старого PvP - иконные механики 1.8.9, воссоздание классического боевого опыта, который знают и любят viele players!

Мод устраняет атаку задержку Introduced в поздних версиях, позволяя для Faster and smoother combat with continuous clicks, just like in the old days. Perfectly designed for PvP enthusiasts, it supports traditional techniques like W-tapping and critical hits, giving you full control over every battle.

Whether you're practicing combos, hosting PvP duels, or simply miss the fast-paced, skill-based sword fights of earlier versions, Old PvP delivers a nostalgic yet polished experience. No delay, no cooldowns — just you, your sword, and your skills.

Функции:

Removes attack cooldowns for fast combo combat

Enables classic mechanics like W-tapping and critical hits

Compatible with shields, but focused on sword-based combat

Ideal for PvP practice maps, arenas, and competitive servers

Faithfully replicates 1.8.9-style fighting in modern Minecraft versions

Step back into the golden age of PvP with Old PvP — where timing, precision, and skill decide the winner!
